shortDescription: This module can be used to assign interfaces to network ports and network IDs to new interfaces.

options.name: description
options.description: Interface name shown in the GUI. Identifier in capital letters if not provided. Input will be trimmed, as no whitespaces are allowed.

options.name: device
options.description: Physical Device Name eg. vtnet0, ipsec1000 etc,.

options.name: identifier
options.description: Technical identifier of the interface, used by hasync for example
